description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic and Woodfall Primus trigger.
Resolve the Hardened Academic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, destroying target noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.
